channel.title: The Healing Pod
channel.description: A meditation show that starts at the very beginning. The Healing Pod builds one episode at a time, from your first conscious breath to deep and steady practice. No experience needed. We learn together, step by step, on a long road toward mastery. Hosted by Alden Isaac.

item.title: The Healing Pod #1 - The Very Beginning
item.description:
The very first episode. We start at the absolute beginning: what meditation actually is, what it is not, how to sit, how to breathe, and your first real five-minute practice, guided start to finish. No experience needed, no special gear, no belief system. Just press play.
Music: "Gymnopedies Nos. 1-3" by Erik Satie, performed by Kevin MacLeod (incompetech.com), licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 (creativecommons.org/licenses/by/3.0).
